request.spec:
A name or alias may no longer be used on a sheet when any sheet of its tree (its ancestors, its
descendants and their descendants, among the sheets that exist) already uses it as a name or alias:
adding, renaming, an alias, the quick-add bar, the paste box (and any later import) are refused as a
duplicate would be. People who already clash are not changed: each shows clashing yes, and every
edit of them through the person form is refused until the edit renames them to a name that does not
clash (and leaves no clashing alias).
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A name or alias may no longer be used on a sheet when any sheet of its tree (its ancestors, its
descendants and their descendants, among the sheets that exist) already uses it as a name or alias:
adding, renaming, an alias, the quick-add bar, the paste box (and any later import) are refused as a
duplicate would be. People who already clash are not changed: each shows clashing yes, and every
edit of them through the person form is refused until the edit renames them to a name that does not

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit

data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Names and aliases now have to be unique across a sheet's whole tree, and `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests.

**How the tree is worked out:** a sheet's tree is its parent, that sheet's parent and so on, plus every sheet below it at any depth. Only sheets that exist count, and loops in the parent links are handled. Names are compared ignoring case.

**What's now refused when the name or alias is already used in the tree:**
- adding a person
- adding an alias
- quick-add (because it creates the person through the same add step)
- the paste box, as before: it only accepts names already on this sheet, so it can't create a new person whose name is taken elsewhere in the tree.

There's no separate import feature in the app, so there was nothing else to change there.

**People who already clash** are left as they are. Each row now has a "Clashing" column (`person-clashing`) showing yes or no, worked out from the store each time it's asked. Saving the person form for someone who clashes is refused unless the new name is free across the tree and none of their aliases clash. One consequence: if an alias is what clashes, the person form can't fix it, so every edit of that person stays refused.

**Two calls you may want to revisit:**
- **Bulk grade skips the tree check.** I read "every edit through the person form" as meaning just that form. So a bulk grade still goes through for people who clash, and it still applies the same-sheet duplicate check as before.
- **Transfer is unchanged.** It still only checks for duplicates on the sheet the person moves to, because the request doesn't list it.

**Where the changes are:**
- **Server:** `PersonService.java` holds the tree lookup and checks, and the clashing calculation. `PersonRepository.java` has two new queries. `PersonController` and `QuickAddController` now return a `clashing` field with each person.
- **Front end:** `features/people/people.ts` has the new field and column.

The refusal message still says the name is "already in use on this sheet", even when the clash is on another sheet in the tree.
